capabilities: Chat with an AI agent in a sidebar panel
Read, search, write, edit, rename, and delete notes via typed tools
Approve, deny, and undo vault changes with diffs
Run skills, subagents, MCP tools, and web research
Track token use and session cost with spend caps
disambiguation: Not a plain chat window; the agent can change your vault through typed tools, with approval gates and undo.
extras: Fully open source under MIT, free, no telemetry; extensive documentation lives at tardigrde.github.io/obsidian-agentic-chat. Web access, MCP, and observability are opt-in and off by default. Installable via BRAT for pre-release builds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent that can act on vault notes with visible tool calls, approval gates, and privacy-controlled model routing.

relations.evidence: Vault tool, path-safety, exact-edit, search, and JSONL session patterns were adapted from lhr0909/pi-obsidian
It runs in Obsidian on desktop and mobile and uses the pi agent packages.
You can use hosted models through OpenRouter, with zero-data-retention routing on by default
or a local Ollama server that keeps requests on your machine.

requires.name: Tavily, Brave, or SearXNG key (web search)

summary: Sidebar AI chat agent that reads, searches, edits, renames, and deletes vault notes through visible, approval-gated tool calls, with privacy-first model routing.
